abi.batch: <export>(startIdx, endIdx, <one pointer per input>, len, <params>, <one pointer per output>, out_len) -> i32. Indices and lengths are u32; an int or enum param is i32, a real one f64; a real buffer holds f64, an int one i32. Each input is read as exactly len elements and each output as exactly out_len. Returns the output count, or a negative value: -retCode when the Rust public tier rejects the call, declinedCode when the export refuses it itself (an enum value naming no member or in that param's declined list, a buffer that is null or misaligned with a non-zero length, an output overlapping another buffer).
abi.fmaProbe: fma_probe(a, b, c) -> f64: a*b+c through the instruction the fused sites use
abi.outRange: out_range() -> address of two u32: the begin index and the count of the last call that succeeded
abi.scratch: scratch(bytes) -> address of at least bytes bytes aligned for f64, kept across calls; a call that grows it moves it. scratch_capacity() -> bytes
